policy: Historical source and safety notes only. Never use these notes or development semantic maps as runtime field candidates, identifiers, coordinates, fallback, or eligibility authority. Inspect the actual PDF and protect agency-only and attestation regions before any synthetic draft.

forms.title: General Intake Sheet
forms.source_kind: One-page extract retaining the scanned official blank form; full official source preserved separately
forms.applicant_boundary: Part I: To be filled out by Client; client/representative and beneficiary identifying information are distinct
forms.protected_boundary: Administrative header/routing above Part I; all Part II: To be Filled out by DSWD Personnel and everything below
cautions: Image-only, zero AcroForm widgets; bilingual labels with small English labels may be uncertain or missed by printed-English OCR
An OCR banner mentioning DSWD personnel is not automatically the staff-only section boundary
Never determine crisis eligibility, select staff sector/disability classifications, make a social-worker assessment, recommend/award assistance, calculate amounts, or fill signatures/approvals

forms.title: Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program Data Request Form
forms.source_kind: Non-default uploaded blank PDF; official published PDF extracted text matches the local snapshot, visually inspected locally; byte identity not verified
forms.requester_boundary: Person making request: name, position, home address, telephone, mobile and email; organization/agency: name, office address, telephone, fax and email. Keep repeated contact labels in their separate source sections.
forms.request_details: Specific purpose and data requirements, with additional sheets if needed; disaggregation (requested breakdown) and time frame (data period); receipt deadline YES/NO and date/reason if YES; preferred output PAPER, E-COPY IN CD or E-COPY VIA EMAIL
printed_conditions: Use requested data only for the specified purposes
Acknowledge Pantawid Pamilya and DSWD as owner and source in all presentations/publications
Electronic data release is in PDF format to avoid alteration
Unauthorized sharing, publishing or duplication in whole or part for any other purpose is strictly prohibited
Provide DSWD a data-utilization feedback report within one month after use; noncompliance forfeits future data-access rights
forms.protected_boundary: Conditions acknowledgment and Signature of Requesting Party with its associated Date; never attest, sign or populate the signature date
cautions: Not AICS crisis assistance, benefit enrollment or beneficiary data updating; never promote this record to an agency default
The requester deadline is not an agency processing commitment; printed conditions are not verified current release policy
Reference notes contain no runtime identifiers, coordinates or mappings; inspect actual structure before any synthetic draft
Do not reuse the person's telephone/email for the organization or infer missing affiliation, purpose, requested breakdown, time frame, deadline or output

forms.title: Personal Record for issuance of SS number
forms.source_kind: Unmodified official three-page text PDF, zero AcroForm widgets
forms.applicant_boundary: Part I: To be filled out by the registrant; only independently mapped synthetic personal/dependent details
forms.protected_boundary: SS-number issuance, Part II: To be filled out by SSS on main/additional sheets, D. Certification, working-spouse consent/signature, fingerprints and signature dates; instruction-only page
cautions: Print information in capital letters and follow printed date formatting only for explicit applicant values
Do not treat missing values as N/A or infer dependent/beneficiary applicability
Do not determine registration qualification, issue an SS number, select approvals or compute contributions/MSC
Historical documentary lists and Flexi-Fund references are not verified current policy
